findings.observation: Existing generic kind tooltip is a concept hint, not a source-specific purpose, inputs/outputs or function behavior explanation. AST-like projection does not contain a semantic fact model.
findings.recommendation: Begin with literal observed syntax facts and source links. Label inferred purpose and unknown runtime values explicitly; do not manufacture explanations from a function name.

recommendedFirstFlow.placement: Reuse existing Structure side panel, progressive Understand subview/action; no new global window, permanent toolbar strip, course screen or auto-popup.
steps: Choose a saved Python definition or bounded selection; show exact version/range, Static—not executed, and coverage.
Show 2–4 literal structural facts linked to highlighted spans; keep generic concept meanings separate from source-specific facts.
Offer 2–3 relevant offline concept chips and optional deeper reference. Keep current editor/map visible and preserve the reading position.
Optional find-the-syntax question or curated separate example; no original mutation, execution or automatic repair.
factsContract: observed facts vs general concepts vs unknowns
newWorkNeeded: Finite concept catalogue and reviewed explanatory text, separate from diagnostic error mappings.
Explicit selected-node/definition adapter; current index click selects only its name and analysis API exposes no external Explain method.
Additional parser projection for parameters/return sites if needed; do not use regular expressions or claim this model exists already.
Shared lifecycle/epoch invalidation and no automatic saving; dirty source needs explicit saved-version choice or a separately designed draft mode.

mustNotClaim: That code ran, passed, is safe, returns a known result/type, takes a certain branch or has a known failure cause.
That call/import targets, side effects, runtime values, dependency availability or actual data flow were resolved.
That complete-range status means CPython validation or full syntax-kind coverage.
That selected substring analysis retains all outer scope/decorator/indentation context.
That a full Python manual, course, debugger, AI tutor or already functioning terminal exists.
That 300k-line range fixtures prove full-file semantic analysis or performance on arbitrary sources.
qualificationRecommendation: Before tutorial UI, repair confirmed assignment omission and retain parser-context/partial cases.
Design-review one compact saved-code flow with beginner and experienced-user tasks; no implementation approval inferred from this inventory.
Test immutable identity, stale source/Lock/late result, unknown/unclassified language, malformed/partial/capped ranges, literal adversarial labels, annotations and augmented assignment semantics.
Reuse existing installed parser/editor/Help primitives; no extra dependency justified for the first finite flow. Evaluate licensed external manual content separately before redistribution.
provenanceLimits: Observed source and in-memory exact parser projection only. No GUI/usability or runtime qualification.
Inspected test files are existing coverage intentions, not newly run test results.
Current capture hash inventory freezes the original offending bytes; future fixes must get separate report and verdict.
Lookup-only errors: src/analysis, tests/source-map.test.mjs and build/guide.mjs absent; actual source paths located. No product failure inferred.
